messages:
Nora Patel: Hi everyone, Nora here (first day!). Trying to provision a small test VM in ap-southeast1 but `gcloud compute instances create` errors with 403. Okta login works. Who owns project provisioning and KMS for APAC? Also need read access to the prod logs S3 bucket for a quick dashboard.

Ibrahim Noor: Welcome Nora! Quick checklist: (1) Make sure your Google identity maps to an org account (Okta -> GCP). (2) Project needs billing linked and `resourcemanager.projectCreator` to create projects. (3) KMS/CMEK requires cloudkms roles. Which project id did you try?

Nora Patel: Tried creating under `redwood-apac-playground`. Not sure if that exists yet. Error: `Permission denied (403) calling resource: cloudresourcemanager.projects.create`.

Ibrahim Noor: Likely missing project creation permission. I'll open a request. @access-bot can you create ticket to provision `redwood-apac-playground` with billing 01A2B3-C456D, enable Compute/KMS/Cloud SQL, and allow ap-southeast1? Tag owner: nora@redwood.ai.

access-bot: Ticket CREATED: PROJ-2026-9450 
Summary: Provision project redwood-apac-playground for nora@redwood.ai. Billing: 01A2B3-C456D. APIs: compute.googleapis.com, cloudkms.googleapis.com, sqladmin.googleapis.com. Allowed regions: ap-southeast1. ETA: 3 hours (can escalate).

Tess Nguyen: Nora 
If you need to demo today, I can grant you a temporary project under our shared team org: `redwood-apac-temp-1`. It already has a keyring `apac-kr` and compute quotas. Ping me and I'll add your IAM binding `roles/viewer` + `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the ring for quick tests.

Nora Patel: Thanks Tess! That'd be perfect. Also asked infra to add me to `aws-logs-readers` for S3 access. Do we use cross-account role or direct group membership?

Ibrahim Noor: We prefer group membership for logs. Which AWS account?

Nora Patel: 123456789012

access-bot: Access change queued: add user nora@redwood.ai to group aws-logs-readers in account 123456789012. No approval required for this group.

Ibrahim Noor: In the meantime, check your mapped GCP email (`gcloud auth list`) and run:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-apac-temp-1
```
to verify roles once Tess adds them. For S3, use `aws s3 ls s3://apac-prod-logs/ --profile redwood` after group add propagates.

Tess Nguyen: Done 
Added Nora to redwood-apac-temp-1 IAM as viewer and granted KMS encrypter on ring `projects/redwood-apac-temp-1/locations/ap-southeast1/keyRings/apac-kr`. Nora, try the VM create now and tell me any firewall/VPC errors. :slightly_smiling_face:

Nora Patel: VM created! :tada: Also `aws s3 ls` shows files now. Will follow up if I hit more policy edge cases. Huge help, thanks all.

access-bot: PROJ-2026-9450 status updated: provisioning started. Escalation: pending if not completed in 3 hours.
